::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_11a — OrgPath and the Identity Governance Plane
:::


::: {.callout-note}
A supplement to chapter 11 — the identity governance plane that sits beyond privileged access. Book 11 governs PIM, RBAC, and the privileged-access alignment; this supplement covers the broader identity lifecycle: Entra ID Governance entitlement management (access packages and catalogs scoped by OrgPath), lifecycle workflows driven by OrgTree change, access reviews and recertification by organizational tier, and SailPoint NERM as the non-employee identity authority — the ADR-059 commercial-cloud carve-out, with its AWS GovCloud boundary caveat called out explicitly. OrgPath is the join key across all of them. Companion to the [Old AD vs New EntraID foundational reference](../learning/old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.qmd).
:::
